lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Partner,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: can you take care of the debris or Raptures on this road for me?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: These are the coordinates.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Sugar told me to relay the message.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Wait just a sec.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: She's in the middle of a delivery.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: If there are any obstacles on the road,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: it'll delay her.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: So she wants you to get rid of it.
I still don't think I fully understand the situation.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: What don't you understand?
How come you're telling me this, and not Sugar?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: That's because

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Sugar's driving right now.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Frima and I are riding behind.
Sounds kinda dangerous.
All three of you are on a motorcycle?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Don't worry, we do this all the time.
What's Frima doing?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Sleeping.
For being on the back of a speeding motorcycle, you seem very relaxed.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Hehehe.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Anyway, I'll leave the Raptures to you.
